title: Christmas Animals
kdp_subtitle: Cute Reindeer, Snowmen and Penguins to Color, with Mazes, Dot-to-Dot and Puzzles | Christmas Gift for Kids Ages 4-8
back_lines: Reindeer, snowmen and penguins are getting ready
for Christmas. Grab your crayons and join the fun!
description:
Get cozy with the cutest animals of Christmas!

Christmas Animals is a big 8.5 x 11 coloring and activity book made for kids ages 4-8. Every page has bold, easy-to-color outlines and a fun job to do.

Inside you will find:
  • Reindeer, snowmen, penguins, bears and kittens in holiday scenes
  • Christmas trees, presents, cookies and candy canes
  • Color-by-number pages with an easy color key
  • Mazes, counting, dot-to-dot, matching and spot-the-difference puzzles
  • Word tracing and a word search for early readers
  • Single-sided pages, so markers will not bleed through
A perfect stocking stuffer and a calm, screen-free activity for the holidays.
